Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original transparent illustrated game UI emblem, for a colorful cartoon water-gun arena game's settings and victory panels.
Primary request: A joyful glossy aqua water-bubble mascot wearing coral red swimming goggles pushed up on its round forehead, small happy face, holding up a chunky golden five-point star medal. A sculptural blue water splash curves behind the mascot with a few floating translucent bubbles. Polished playful 2.5D mobile/PC cartoon action game illustration, clean confident navy edge lines, bright white specular highlights, cyan, coral, sunny yellow.
Composition: single centered compact emblem, square image, all elements fit comfortably with transparent padding. Strong readable silhouette even at 160px. Transparent background, no ground plane, no rectangular backdrop.
Constraints: original character, no known franchise characters, no letters, no text, no logos, no watermark. This is a finished decorative UI asset, not a screenshot or UI mockup.
